confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and supplied comparables, not live listings; assumes roughly 1.33 USD per GBP. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are July peak-season guesses with wider uncertainty (roughly 25% or more). Cocktail and wine were checked against the local beer price because direct knowledge is only moderate. FX came from RBA-domain search summaries without opening the RBA page, and the summaries conflicted on 14 October, so verify the 15 October value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied comparables: coffee and inexpensive meal close to Edinburgh, mid-range meal between Edinburgh and Reykjavik, beer between Vienna and Reykjavik, hotels about 10% above Edinburgh, and hostel beds about 1.8 to 1.9 times Edinburgh to reflect London's premium.
